svg.title: StockResearchAgents system context
svg.desc: A caller runtime coordinates the public company-analytics.v1 profile through the coordination MCP and retrieves typed evidence through a separate stock-research-data MCP. StockResearchAgents validates the outer CompanyAnalyticsSubmissionV1, including its embedded CompanyResearchSubmissionV1 and ResearchDossierV1 foundation, before publishing CompanyAnalyticsResultV1 for projection-only viewers and exports.
